name: Sarah Khan
text: The hilsa curry from Fatema B. was exactly how my mom used to make it. Highly recommended!

name: Rafiq H.
text: Love the healthy keto options from Shirin. It makes sticking to my diet so much easier while working from home.

name: Nadia A.
text: Finally, clean street food! The fuchka was amazing and I didn't have to worry about hygiene.

name: Imtiaz Ahmed
text: I grew up on Nazira Bazar kacchi and I am hard to please. Tanvir's is the real thing. The mutton fell apart.

name: Tahmina R.
text: Ordered bhapa pitha in the middle of August and it tasted like a winter morning at my nanu's house.

name: Shakib Hossain
text: Paratha and dim bhaji at my door at 7am sharp, every single morning this month. Never once late.

name: Faria Chowdhury
text: The weekly lunch plan has saved me from another year of canteen food. Portions are generous for the price.

name: Anika Tabassum
text: Seven bhortas for 280 taka and every one of them was distinct. As a vegetarian I usually get one sad option.

name: Mahmudul Karim
text: Ordered the family tray for my daughter's birthday. Fourteen people, not a grain left. The borhani was perfect.

name: Dr. Salma Begum
text: I recommend Momena to my own patients now. Carb counts on every box and my sugar readings have held steady.

name: Rezwana Islam
text: Laila's brownies are dangerous. The custom cake for my husband's birthday looked better than the bakery ones.

name: Arman Sheikh
text: You can taste that it is real charcoal. Kebabs arrived still warm. Would have liked more salad in the box.

name: Sadia Noor
text: Ordered the iftar platter through all of Ramadan. Always before azan, never once soggy. The haleem is excellent.

name: Pritom Das
text: Sujon messaged me to say koi was not good that morning and offered pabda instead. That kind of honesty is rare.

name: Rumana Haque
text: Been in Dhaka eleven years and never found proper shatkora beef until now. Tasted like going home to Sylhet.

name: Nafis Iqbal
text: Proper mezbani heat, no compromise for Dhaka tastes. Order the rice with it, you will need it.
